preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(type in ['AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', 'IN'] for type in vertex_types)
preconditions.description: Every vertex type is one of the allowed logical elements or input.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= val <= 1 for val in input_values)
preconditions.description: Every input vertex has a value of 0 or 1.
The graph forms a valid tree rooted at vertex 1 where leaves (excluding root) are inputs and internal nodes are logical elements with correct arity.

postconditions.description: The output string length equals the number of input vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip()[i] == str(compute_output_with_flipped_input(input_indices[i], original_input_values, vertex_types, children_map, n)) for i in range(len(input_indices)))
postconditions.description: For each input vertex in ascending order of indices, the corresponding character in the output is the result of the logical scheme when that specific input's value is flipped (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0) and all other inputs remain unchanged.
